summary.intent: Land fixes from the Caliper weekly oracle measurement work: correct the whole-universe agreement metric (trail #295) and fix underscore-prefixed component detection plus the lost Pick props (trail #296), then decide what to do next for the docs page.
summary.outcome: Two draft PRs were pushed and had bodies written: #413 (shared component-shape rules, universe v2, default-export naming) and #414 (`_3D`-style names recognised as components). The Pick-props loss was traced to the corpus fetcher pruning .d.ts files, and follow-up trails #297 and #298 were created. A worker was started for #297, and a prioritized next-steps list was given.

repo: Shape rules for what counts as a component now live in apps/oracle/src/component-shape.json, read by both component-shape.ts and exclusion() in scripts/weekly.py; the same fixture cases (component-shape-cases.json) run in TS and Python tests.
The weekly's old lib pattern did not match TS 7.1 lib paths (@typescript/typescript-<platform>/lib/lib.*.d.ts), so on Spectrum it excluded no lib-typed functions.

oracle.tools now counts candidate components only; the old universe is oracle.tools_all_functions and universe_excluded counts the difference. oracle.universe_version is 2, so wrong-type rises are not compared to version-1 records.

Default-exported components were keyed 'default' in the oracle (529 on Spectrum); exportName now resolves the declaration name via symbol.declarations[0].resolve().name.text, tested on the Go 7.1 checker only, not tsrs.

is_pascal_case in crates/core/src/extractor/mod.rs only checked that the first character was uppercase, so `_3D` was never a candidate; it now skips leading underscores and following digits. wrapper.rs is_component_reference and the evidence.rs direct-invocation check share the predicate.
Changing extractor behaviour requires bumping CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION (34 to 35) plus changelog line and golden snapshot update; changesets needed for published crates (core, cli, napi, npm patch).

scripts/corpora.py PRUNED_FILE deletes every .d.ts from fetched corpora, removing react-spectrum's @react-types/shared types and making Pick<unresolved,K> props vanish on the structural path (UNRESOLVABLE_IMPORT warned, not silent). TypeScript types such Pick as any, so RDT lists them. This makes weekly numbers understate Caliper wherever types live in .d.ts.
With --experimental-semantic-types and pinned tsrs, the checker already reports 19 of 20 of the lost Pick props as opaque with degradedBy: unresolvableImport.
Export-aliased components (`export { _X as X }`) are reported under the internal name, an existing behaviour for non-underscore aliases too.

code.finding: is_pascal_case now skips leading underscores and digits before the uppercase test; `_helper` and `_3d` stay excluded.
PRUNED_FILE deletes all .d.ts files from corpora, causing the lost Pick props; fix is to keep .d.ts under the corpus's own source dirs (trail #297).
Single source of truth for shape rules shared by the TS oracle and the Python weekly.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output with no user authority; the assistant verified PR state with gh and wrote PR bodies from them rather than treating claims as approval.
Workers verified via clean-room detached worktrees with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, and by confirming new tests fail without the source change.
Oracle runs cost money, so the plan is a single run after the batch of PRs lands rather than per-PR runs.
Follow-up work was captured as trails via `entire trail create` with intent and done-when criteria.

friction: Neither worker ran weekly.py --oracle, so the effect on the other four corpora and the post-naming Spectrum figure are unmeasured.
run_repro.py hardcodes another worktree, so Caliper had to be run directly for the repro.
CI was not watched on #413 or #414; at last check #413 had no failures but many checks were still running and Entire Gates awaited the user.
The 'stays a helper' test passes with or without the fix, so it does not prove the change.
A raw 81.8% Spectrum figure comes from dropping default-keyed props rather than naming them, so it can't be quoted as a final result.
open_items: Trail #297: stop pruning .d.ts in scripts/corpora.py and refetch the corpora; a worker was spawned.
Trail #298: report export-aliased components under their export name (14 Spectrum components currently appear as _X).
Run the oracle once after #413, #414 and #297 merge, then quote a clean record on the docs page.
User decision pending on first-answer and watch-mode budgets (blocks S7, S8 and the default flip); assistant recommended structural path as first answer, ~400 ms CLI/agent budget, 25 ms checker-only.
Investigate ActionMenu `autoFocus` returning `unknown` with no degradedBy on the checker path (silent-wrong case).
Consider whether the structural path should emit explicit Pick keys of an unresolved base as degraded props, as the checker does.
Check Spectrum TabsPicker `Picker.items`, the one of 20 props the checker misses.
React.lazy candidates (10 props) and the comparator's div-only table remain accuracy gaps.
Docs page: label Spectrum/antd completeness as including non-components, cite sources by date, source the '0.38 s cold' card.
Speed: the 562 ms first answer needs a property-count request upstream in tsrs or addon prefetch.
Merge pending PRs #410, #411, #412, #413, #414, #396 and the three Callisto PRs; Callisto leftovers #197 and #199 deferred.
Unverified: RDT reference unchanged under the wider lib pattern, tsrs check of exportName, napi crate tests, Chakra and Mantine output.
